name: Lakskongen Sustainability Configuration
description: Scoring thresholds and certification requirements for the sustainability system

seaLice.description: Female lice per fish thresholds. <0.2 = excellent, 0.2-0.5 = acceptable, >0.5 = poor

escapes.description: Annual escape count. Zero = perfect, 1-10 = acceptable, >10 = poor

feed.description: Sustainable feed source percentage. 80%+ recommended. Bonus for insect meal/algae

carbon.description: Renewable energy percentage. 50%+ target. Bonus for electric vessels

welfare.description: Stocking density as ratio of max allowed. <80% = good. Bonus for humane slaughter

ecosystem.description: Seabed health (70%+ healthy) and nutrient discharge (kg/day max)

descriptions.esgInvestmentBonus: 30% subsidy on green tech investments at 80+ score

categoryWeights.description: Point allocation per category. Total must equal 100.

NonCompliant.restrictions: Cannot export to EU, USA, Japan. Major buyers refuse contracts.

BasicCompliance.restrictions: Standard markets only. No premium buyers.

ASCCertified.restrictions: None. Access to premium retail chains.

extraBenefits: Lower interest rates on loans (ESG investors)
